serviceStep.title: Choose Coaching Service
serviceStep.description: Select which timeline upgrade program you wish to coordinate with Dr. Tomorrow.

intakeStep.title: Future Intake Questionnaire
intakeStep.description: Please complete this brief questionnaire so Dr. Tomorrow can audit your trajectory.

fields.label: What is Future You most frustrated about?
fields.placeholder: e.g. My tendency to buy gym memberships and spend evenings on the couch.

fields.label: What goal have you delayed the longest?
fields.placeholder: e.g. Launching my side business / Learning to speak Spanish.

fields.label: If nothing changed, where would you be in five years?
fields.placeholder: e.g. In the exact same job, feeling slightly more tired and regretful.

fields.label: What would make Future You proud?
fields.placeholder: e.g. Shipping a product with 100 paying customers.

fields.label: What is your biggest obstacle today?
fields.placeholder: e.g. Terrible focus management and checking social feeds every 10 minutes.

fields.label: What have you already tried?
fields.placeholder: e.g. Buying planners, reading atomic habits twice, setting screen time limits.

fields.label: Why are you seeking help now?
fields.placeholder: e.g. Tired of dreaming about a life I know I can build if I just execute.

scheduleStep.title: Schedule Your Alignment Slot
scheduleStep.description: Select your preferred space-time coordinates for the session.

successStep.title: Booking Complete!
successStep.description: Dr. Tomorrow has locked in your coordinates. We are currently listening for the quantum notification of your session.
successStep.note: Note: If you receive this session request five years ago, please ignore it. That was a calibration error. Otherwise, see you in alignment!
